research_goal: Test whether selectively updating numeric test-time fast weights on repeated action-effect sign contradictions improves causal adaptation, OOD transfer, cold retention and whole-process efficiency relative to equally exposed trained controls.

provenance.semantics: The original G5 official TTT language stack is token-based. This scientific design concerns a continuous numeric fast-weight TTT adapter; never describe it as an already-qualified official Mamba2+TTT integrated GPU architecture.
provenance.s24_dependency: S25 must remain an isolated research pilot. Do not promote S25 into S24 evaluation or claim JEPA integration until S24 independent qualification.

hypotheses.H0: A contradiction-gated numeric TTT fast-weight adapter with eight online updates of identical cost can attain lower heldout intervention MSE than periodic conventional, uniform-random and surprise-triggered eight-update TTT.
hypotheses.H1: The advantage is causal rather than generic residual magnitude: coherent observed action-effect sign reversals trigger additional useful updates while equal-magnitude errors without sign contradiction do not.
hypotheses.H2: After adaptation to an unfamiliar sign-reversal dynamics family, original-world competence cold-retains and action-transfer success survives independent seeds, no extra information and no increase in matched total compute.
hypotheses.falsification: Failure against strongest competent control, unlearnable control worlds, sign/magnitude leakage, missing paired clone equivalence, incomplete baseline, weak retention, unstable seeds or CPU cost overrun is scientific NULL/FAIL.

mechanism.gate_history: At each t, predict both action probe outcomes using ONLY prior state. Observe both probe outcomes, then decide whether one permitted online update occurs. No future observations or evaluator labels.
mechanism.contrast_uncertainty: train-only noise sigma sensor=0.002; paired observation difference sigma=sqrt(2)*0.002; no use of true x,z or coefficients
mechanism.contradiction_definition: predicted and observed paired action-effect signs oppose AND both have absolute magnitude >=0.012 AND absolute difference >=0.018
mechanism.persistent_contradiction_gate: at least 2 contradictions within most recent 3 causally observed steps (including current step)
mechanism.surprise_gate: absolute primary prequential residual >=0.018; no action-effect sign checks
mechanism.random_gate: uniform without replacement under a fixed count using seeded online remaining-slots selection
mechanism.online_budget: 32 observations per episode; exactly eight real fast-weight updates per equal-budget arm; enforce remaining-slot fallback as necessary; full-update reference has 32 real updates and is costed separately
mechanism.allowed_update_target: Only numeric TTT fast-weight online parameter(s); trained slow encoder/GRU/backbone, episode inputs and capacity identical; same optimizer, learning rate, clips, starting weights and update data across arms.
forbidden: unmatched paired actions or observation budget

world.base: exact G7-S20 partially observed x,z dynamics and noisy y=x+0.25z; do not rewrite original source
world.paired_intervention_method: At each observed time t, clone the same hidden physical state for a (+0.8,-0.8) paired probe and return only two numeric sensor measurements. All arms receive the same paired observations and actual training targets. Physical state and coefficient truth remain evaluator-private.
transfer_worlds: unfamiliar nonlinear rational family with action-effect reversal
world.observability_caveat: This is simulator-clone paired probing and is not a real-world demonstration of causal identification.

arms.periodic_TTT: Conventional numeric fast-weight TTT with fixed periodic K=8 schedule
arms.random_TTT: Same numeric TTT, stochastic online K=8 gate sampled without replacement
arms.surprise_TTT: Same numeric TTT, prediction-error threshold with K=8 budget
arms.contradiction_TTT: Same numeric TTT, persistent signed action-contrast disagreement with K=8 budget
arms.full_update_TTT: Same TTT with K=32 (stronger conventional reference, separately costed and not called equal-compute)
arms.GRU_fully_trained: Independent fully trained recurrent numeric action-conditioned predictor; trained to frozen validation plateau before evaluation
arms.RBF_KRR: Train-only calibrated conventional kernel regression positive control
arms.oracle: Private physical simulator to check target learnability; not a fair learned comparator
ablations: shuffle action labels after generation only
remove sign check but keep absolute residual threshold
remove paired probes from ALL treatment arms

budgets.conventional_validation_plateau: After >=640 updates, 5 validation-only spaced evaluations with <0.1% relative improvement; max 1600 updates; if no competent convergence science INVALID.
budgets.optimizer: same precommitted numeric fast-weight SGD and step size 0.001 across arms
budgets.equal_budget_rule: All K=8 arms share exact slow model checkpoint, numeric fast-weight dimensions, actions, observed transitions, update step gradient cost and real-update count. Same forward/probe work and supervision budget. Account for gate overhead and full source-training cost.
budgets.frozen_budget_stop: Abort without qualification on missing package/source custody, time/peak memory overruns, baseline nonconvergence, sample mismatch or unsanctioned GPU/system changes.

science_gates.interpretation: Any representation-only, diagnosis-only, synthetic cue exploitation or infrastructure PASS is NOT SCIENTIFIC_PASS.

qualification.phase0: Pure deterministic gate tests and protocol/source checks on engineering-only seeds; no scientific data generation, no training.
qualification.phase1: Implement continuous numeric fast weights and fully trained conventional baselines; targeted component controls and final exact-head full required-platform regression with receipts.
qualification.phase2: Separate first-use operator/project-scoped authorization, sealed-world registration, source provenance and no-posthoc-change custody before running any frozen fit/heldout science seeds.
qualification.phase3: Independent faithful reproduction, whole-process resource accounting and separate scientific review/admission.

authority.allowed_now: prepare isolated source, frozen protocol, engineering-only tests and code review; do not run sealed experiment
